title: 3265. Count Almost Equal Pairs I

examples.explanation: The almost equal pairs of elements are: 3 and 30. By swapping 3 and 0 in 30, you get 3. 12 and 21. By swapping 1 and 2 in 12, you get 21.
Every two elements in the array are almost equal.
We cannot swap any two digits of 123 or 231 to reach the other.
